methods.name: session.workspace.move

methods.name: setup.status
methods.summary: Loose provider check: is ANY provider auth state discoverable for the (launch or named) profile.

params.description: Any method the desktop may route to a named profile (``requestGatewayForProfile`` adds ``profile``).
params.title: ProfileParams

methods.name: shared_metrics.desktop_daily
methods.summary: Record one finished Desktop day (mode use + button presses); recorded=false keeps it for a retry.

params.description:
One finished UTC day of Desktop use, aggregated on the client. ``day`` (YYYY-MM-DD) only latches
a resend and is never recorded; the raw counts are bucketed by the backend.
params.title: SharedMetricsDesktopDailyParams

methods.name: shared_metrics.desktop_dislike
methods.summary: Count one Desktop dislike signal (fire-and-forget; capped per signal per day; a no-op unless on).

params.description:
``signal`` quick_close|cancelled|setting_off_default|rage_click|undo|feature_disabled; ``target`` a
closed code-defined id for that signal (area, flow, action, undo path, feature toggle); ``setting`` a
config key for setting_off_default only (the value is never sent — the backend compares it to the
default).
params.title: SharedMetricsDesktopDislikeParams

methods.name: shared_metrics.desktop_feature_use
methods.summary: Count one Desktop area used today (fire-and-forget; once per area per UTC day; a no-op unless on).

params.description:
``area`` is a Desktop surface id (``command_palette``, ``terminal_pane``, ``settings_<view>`` …);
the backend collapses anything outside its closed set to ``other``.
params.title: SharedMetricsDesktopFeatureUseParams

methods.name: shared_metrics.desktop_friction
methods.summary: Count one Desktop friction event (fire-and-forget; capped per day; a no-op unless on).

params.description:
``kind`` notice_dismissed|error_toast|renderer_crash|backend_disconnect|slow_frame; ``detail`` a
closed code-defined word for that kind (notice id, error category, crash reason, drop reason, frame
duration bucket), never message text.
params.title: SharedMetricsDesktopFrictionParams

methods.name: shared_metrics.desktop_onboarding
methods.summary: Count one Desktop first-run step transition (fire-and-forget; once per step+event; a no-op unless on).

params.description: ``step`` a Desktop first-run step id; ``event`` reached|completed|abandoned.
params.title: SharedMetricsDesktopOnboardingParams

methods.name: shared_metrics.set
methods.summary: Write both shared-metrics opt-ins at once (send requires collection) and reconcile consent windows.

params.description: ``send`` is ignored unless ``enabled``; ``first_run`` marks the Desktop first-run answer.
params.title: SharedMetricsSetParams

methods.name: shared_metrics.slash_command
methods.summary: Count one user-typed slash command (fire-and-forget; a no-op unless shared metrics are on).

params.description:
``command`` is the raw typed name (no leading ``/``, no args); the backend canonicalizes it
against the published registry. ``session_id`` scopes the count to that session's profile.
params.title: SharedMetricsSlashCommandParams

methods.name: shared_metrics.startup_latency
methods.summary: Record one client launch-to-ready latency (fire-and-forget; a no-op unless shared metrics are on).

params.description:
``elapsed_ms`` = the client's own launch (TUI process start / Desktop app start) to ready
(TUI gateway ready / Desktop backend attached), measured once per launch by the client. The
client names its surface because a Desktop may attach to a URL/cloud backend where
``HERMES_DESKTOP`` is unset; without it the backend falls back to its own client detection.
``launch_id`` is an opaque per-launch token the backend latches on (never recorded), so a
reconnect re-sending the same launch counts once while a new launch counts again.
params.title: SharedMetricsStartupLatencyParams

methods.name: shared_metrics.status
methods.summary: Pure read of the focused profile's shared-metrics opt-ins (collection, upload, answered).

params.description: Any method the desktop may route to a named profile (``requestGatewayForProfile`` adds ``profile``).
params.title: ProfileParams

methods.name: shared_metrics.update_run
methods.summary: Count one Desktop packaged self-update outcome (fire-and-forget; a no-op unless shared metrics are on).

params.description:
One Desktop PACKAGED self-update (electron-updater / App Installer / Store). Source-checkout
hand-offs run ``hermes update`` and are counted from its receipt, never here. Raw words; the
backend buckets them: ``outcome`` success|failed|noop|refused, ``failed_stage``
download|verify|apply|restart, ``mechanism`` the updater strategy kind, ``duration_ms`` wall
time, ``from_commit_date`` the updated-from build's commit time (epoch seconds) when known.
params.title: SharedMetricsUpdateRunParams

methods.name: shell.exec
